name: Mishka
source:
Occupation: Assassin
Likes: Sasha, knives, clubs
Dislikes: Not being with Sasha, his boss

Mishka's rather co-dependent and struggles to maintain relationships without the help of his best friend and love interest to buffer interactions. He's very protective of Sasha and will not hesitate to eliminate any and all threats. When he is not around Sasha, he's often spending his time training his skills to keep up with the demands of his job.
